title: Contrarian Angles
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of contrarian-angle-generator. Lists angles that challenge a widely-held assumption in the surveyed literature. Each angle carries challenged_assumption, so it is a direct classify_gap signal that maps to (assumption_gap, ASSUMPTION) — rule 2 in the priority table. An empty angles array is allowed (the surveyed work may have no challengeable assumptions). Every present item carries at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop).

angles.description: Contrarian angles challenging assumptions; each carries challenged_assumption so classify_gap can consume it directly.

challenged_assumption.description: The specific assumption being challenged. Non-blank required.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers grounding this contrarian angle (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

supporting_argument.description: Optional argument supporting why the assumption is challengeable.
